title: Tanzanian Coastal Mezze
community: Tanzanian restaurant opening course — the coastal small plates tradition
author: Chef Fatuma
desc: Tanzanian Coastal Mezze — a sharing board of miniature coastal Tanzanian preparations. Zanzibar-spiced hummus, bhajia with chatni ya Nazi, mini mishkaki, avocado kachumbari, cassava chips with pili pili mayo, and warm chapati triangles. The Tanzanian coastal kitchen as a sharing board — the finest starter in modern Tanzanian restaurants.
longDesc: The Tanzanian coastal mezze is the modern restaurant's most sophisticated interpretation of Zanzibar's street food tradition — each element drawn from the island's food culture, miniaturised and refined, and assembled on a beautiful wooden board. It is the Forodhani night market translated to fine dining.
ingredients: ½ tsp smoked paprika for topping
// Pili Pili Mayo (4 tbsp mayo + 2 tbsp pili pili)
equipment: Large wooden board or mezze plate
steps: Zanzibar hummus: blend chickpeas, tahini, garlic, lemon, cumin, and cardamom until smooth. Drizzle olive oil. Dust paprika.
Make avocado kachumbari: combine kachumbari with diced avocado.
Board assembly: hummus in a bowl (centre). Bhajia, mishkaki, chips arranged around. Sauces in ramekins. Chapati triangles upright. Avocado kachumbari in a bowl.
chefTips: The cardamom in the hummus is the Zanzibar signature — essential.
Everything must be hot when assembled except the hummus and kachumbari.
Build height on the board — different textures at different heights is more visually engaging.
Serve with extra lime wedges — acidity lifts everything on the board.
cookingScience: The Zanzibar hummus adds cardamom (1,8-cineole) to the classic chickpea preparation — this aromatic compound is fat-soluble and dissolves into the tahini's sesame oil, distributing evenly through the hummus. At the serving temperature (room temperature), the 1,8-cineole volatilises, producing the characteristic Zanzibar fragrance that differentiates this hummus immediately.
sustainabilityTips: Every component from the Tanzanian coast — zero food miles.
reheating: Reheat fried items. Hummus and kachumbari served at room temperature.
healthBenefits: Healthy fats from avocado and olive oil.
culturalNote: The Tanzanian coastal mezze is the dish that Tanzania's best restaurants serve to international guests to demonstrate what the country's food culture is — diverse, proud, rooted in tradition, and executed with modern confidence. It is Tanzania saying 'sit down, let us show you who we are'.
